title: Inkwell-Example
body:
This is an example datapack generated by Inkwell using the example preset. It includes NPC's from the main example plugin (farmer, blacksmith, shopkeep, john, terry) without any of the testing override plugins (changing johns dialogue, deleting terry's dialogues) - (place a villager down, nametag it one of these names, run [/function inkwell:give_translator], right click the villager)

Find Inkwell here:
https://github.com/ItsNotPaths/Inkwell

Requires Iris-utils datapack to also be installed for the correct mc version:
https://github.com/Aeldrion/Iris
